name: Chapel gatehouse
description: Stone gatehouse in the manner of a small chapel, 12.8 x 7.2 m: a round-arched carriage passage with a barrel vault runs through the middle under a steep slate roof crowned by a bellcote; the porter's lodge opens off the passage on one side, a small chapel with lancet windows, an altar and its own front door on the other.

steps.note: leave by the chapel front door
